purpose: SOP 2 - hardware and base runtime environment collection; device identity and hardware specification

collection.collected_at_local_tz_note: Board clock runs in UTC. 21:08:24Z = 2026-10-19 05:08:24 +0800 Asia/Taipei.
collection.method: read-only shell collection; no config change, no reboot, no service kill, no benchmark, no secret collection

field_status_legend.official_spec: official vendor specification (vendor manual / board datasheet)
field_status_legend.system_report: value reported by the running operating system (/proc, /sys, standard tools)
field_status_legend.tool_report: value reported by a vendor or third-party tool (icraft, lspci, ethtool, ...)
field_status_legend.measured: value observed on site during this collection (link negotiation, free space, load)
field_status_legend.unverified: not cross-checked against a second source
field_status_legend.not_supported: the platform does not expose the field at all
field_status_legend.not_accessible: the field exists but could not be read with the privileges used

machine_id.note: matches the /mnt/wcroot image snapshot in ../board_extract/26_system_identity.txt, i.e. this board runs the stock vendor image

device_type.rationale: no /.dockerenv, no container markers in /proc/1/mountinfo, PID 1 is systemd, cgroup v2 memory.max and cpu.max are absent

host_relationship.note: not a VM, not a container; there is no host layer to describe

vendor.value: FMSH / Fudan Microelectronics (复旦微), FPAI series

soc_model_from_device_tree.note: device tree model string; this is what the running kernel reports as Machine model

documented_board_name.value: FMQL30TAI (完整版) / JFMQL30TAI676H (轻量版) - FPAI 悟净开发板

model_discrepancy.observed: Device tree reports 'FMQLMP FMQL100TAI'; the vendor manual in this repo documents the 悟净 board as FMQL30TAI / JFMQL30TAI676H. The two names are not reconciled by any document in this repository.
model_discrepancy.impact: The 官方规格 values quoted from the manual (FPGA logic, LUT, BRAM, DSP, TOPS) are attributed to the FMQL30TAI part; whether they apply verbatim to the FMQL100TAI silicon on this board is unconfirmed.
model_discrepancy.action: ask FMSH whether FMQL100TAI is a silicon-step or SKU rename of FMQL30TAI before quoting the manual's resource numbers as this board's specification

board_revision.note: no serial-number or board-name property in the device tree; no revision register was readable

architecture.cross_checked_on_site: NPU (arm china,linlon-v5) and FPGA (fpga_manager fpga0, state=operating) both present; GPU (arm,mali-bifrost) additionally present

microarchitecture.value: ARMv8-A (ARMv8.0-A), implementer 0x41, part 0xd03, revision 4, stepping r0p4

logical_cpus.note: Thread(s) per core = 1, so physical == logical; no SMT

max_frequency.note: no cpufreq driver, no cpu_opp_table in the device tree, operating-points-v2 is commented out in the shipped DTB, and cpu@0 has no clock-frequency property. The vendor manual states 最高1GHz (official_spec) but no on-site reading could confirm the running clock.

bogomips.note: reported per core; not a frequency measurement and must not be read as 200 MHz or 100 MHz

governor.note: no cpufreq sysfs interface is present

temperature.note: the platform exposes no thermal zone; /sys/class/thermal contains no thermal_zone* node

numa_topology.note: numactl is not installed; dmesg shows a single node with 262144 total pages, which is consistent with a single NUMA node but was not confirmed with a topology query

ram_total.note: the kernel was told mem=1024M on the command line, so the usable total is 1 GiB minus kernel reservation

ram_type.detail: Fudan Micro 4Gb devices, 16-bit data interface, Fly-By topology, 1600 MHz part speed, theoretical 1600MHz x 32bit = 51.2 Gbps

ram_channels.note: the manual describes a Fly-By topology over 16-bit devices but the on-site memory controller configuration was not read out

ram_bandwidth.note: no bandwidth measurement was performed; SOP 2 forbids performance runs. Theoretical value is 51.2 Gbps (official_spec) but was not measured.

pl_side_ddr.note: PL-side memory is not visible in the PS memory tree; not verifiable from the running system

on_chip_sram.note: not exposed to Linux, so not verifiable on site

l1_instruction.on_site_structure: cache index1, level 1, type Instruction, shared_cpu_map=1 (private per core)
l1_instruction.note: sysfs size attribute is absent for every index; the shipped DTB l2-cache node carries only 'compatible' and 'phandle' and no cache-size property, so the kernel cannot publish the capacity

l1_data.on_site_structure: cache index0, level 1, type Data, shared_cpu_map=1 (private per core)

l2.on_site_structure: cache index2, level 2, type Unified, shared_cpu_map=f (shared by all 4 cores); device tree node l2-cache status=okay

root_filesystem.note: used share rose from 19G/78% in batch 1 to 20G/80% in batch 3; the collection itself and the board's own background work account for the difference

sd_card.partitions: p1 = 1 GiB (FAT boot partition), p2 = 26.1 GiB (rootfs)
sd_card.note: the manual specifies a 32 GB TF-CARD; the card actually fitted reports 58.4 GiB. Partition layout matches the 58.42 GiB / 26.08 GiB card recorded in ../psdev.md.

emmc.partition: p1 = 29.1 GiB ext4, boot0/boot1 = 4 MiB each

mount_state.batch_3: not mounted; /mnt/wcis-emmc is empty and df resolves it to the root filesystem
mount_state.note: the eMMC mount came and went between the two collection batches. Do not assume it is mounted.

qspi_nor.partitions: mtd0 'bootloader' 4 MiB, mtd1 'kernel' 16 MiB, mtd2 'rootfs' 0 bytes
qspi_nor.cross_check: manual states one 256Mb QSPI FLASH (QSPI0) - matches the official_spec

vendor.value: FMSH / Arm China - ZG330 iCore (诸葛架构)

npu.correction: 2026-10-23 (D-79): the 'device_tree_node', 'driver_probe', 'compute_units' and 'accessible_by_system' entries that previously stood here described the VPU (video codec: mve@F0020000 / Linlon V5276 / amvx). They are now recorded under the 'vpu' key after this block. The ZG330 iCore has no device-tree node, no kernel module and no /dev node. Raw logs were left intact.

device_tree_node.note: grepping the flattened device tree for 'npu', 'aiu', 'zhuge' and 'icore' returns 0 hits - the ZG330 iCore lives in the PL and has no device-tree presence. The only 'vpu' node in the tree is the video codec (see the 'vpu' key below).

access_path.note: reached only through two PL AXI slave windows mapped from the PS side; userland talks to it with the icraft / zg330 runtime over /dev/mem

ai_throughput.value: 8 TOPS @ INT8; 4 TFLOPS @ FP16; 2 TFLOPS @ TF32
ai_throughput.note: vendor figure; no workload was run to verify it (SOP 2 forbids benchmarks)

device_node.note: no /dev node is exported for the NPU and there is no NPU kernel module at all - the amvx module and /dev/udmabuf0 belong to the VPU, not the NPU (corrected 2026-10-23, D-79)

accessible_by_system.value: no - no driver, no /dev node, no device-tree node
accessible_by_system.note: the 'driver bound and scheduling threads active' reading that previously stood here describes the VPU driver (mvx_sched threads on f0020000.mve), not the NPU

vendor.value: Arm China - Linlon V5276 video codec (MVX family)

device_tree_node.value: vpu: mve@F0020000, compatible = 'arm china,linlon-v5', reg 0xF0020000 size 0x10000, IRQ GIC_SPI 69, clock-names 'clk_vpu'

driver_probe.value: MVX dev: Linlon v5276 identified. cores=2, nlsid=4, id=0. (mvx_dev.c:427)
driver_probe.note: the video codec driver probes at ~9.5 s after boot and registers platform device f0020000.mve with live kernel threads kworker/u8:{1,2}-mvx_sched and kworker/u8:3-f0020000.mve

kernel_module.note: modinfo describes it as 'Tiube VPU Driver'; it is a video codec driver, not an NPU driver

compute_units.note: driver-reported codec core count and NLS id count - unrelated to the ZG330 iCore 官方规格 TOPS figure

device_node.note: not from this SOP-2 collection: npu_dev.txt reports 'no dedicated /dev node', which is true for the NPU but wrong for the VPU. This value comes from the 2026-10-05 VPU codec probe.

firmware.note: mpeg4dec, avs2dec, vp9dec, h264enc, h264enc.prot-ver, jpegdec, avsdec, mpeg2dec, vp8enc, hevcdec, rvdec, h264dec, vp8dec, vc1dec, hevcenc, jpegenc, vp9enc. Every file is a video codec firmware, which settles that this block is a codec and not an AI accelerator.

accessible_by_system.value: yes - driver bound and scheduling threads active

model.value: Mali GPU, DDK r31p0-01eac0, GPU id 0x2, 'arch 7.4.0 r1p0'
model.note: the driver does not print a marketing model name. Arch 7.4.0 r1p0 corresponds to Mali-G52 in the Arm GPU architecture mapping, but that name is an interpretation of the arch string, not a directly reported value.

device_tree_node.value: mali_gpu@f0000000, compatible 'arm,mali-bifrost', status okay; companion mali_mgm (arm,physical-memory-group-manager) okay

coherency.value: coherency mode 31, set from device tree

memory.note: the physical memory group manager probed successfully, but no GPU memory size is published in sysfs and the debugfs gpuinfo path is not populated

in_official_spec.note: the vendor manual's FMQL30TAI resource table lists CPU, NPU and FPGA only; the Mali GPU is present in the shipped device tree but is not part of the published specification table

vendor.value: FMSH - integrated programmable logic in the FMQL SoC

manager.value: fpga_manager fpga0, name 'FMSH FMQL FPGA Manager', device -> e0040000.devcfg, state = operating
manager.note: the bitstream is already loaded at run time; the 'firmware' attribute is write-only and the loaded bitstream identity is not exposed in sysfs

load_path.value: U-Boot loads 'download.bit' from mmc 0:2 into the PL at boot (uEnv.txt loadbit variable), and the Linux fpga_manager reports state=operating
load_path.note: the state was already 'operating' when collection started, so no bitstream was programmed during this collection

ff_count.note: not present in the manual's resource table and not readable from the running board

uram.note: not present in the manual's resource table and not readable from the running board

clock.value: PS side 50 MHz, PL side 200 MHz
clock.note: PL-side clock frequencies actually in use by the loaded bitstream were not measured

actual_design_utilisation.critical_note: SOP 2 forbids presenting design occupancy as measured resources. No FPGA utilisation report or tool output was produced or collected, so the occupancy of LUT/BRAM/DSP by the running bitstream is unknown. The numbers in logic_resources are device capacities, not usage.

dma_controllers.value: 2 controllers, 8 channels each: dw_dmac e004b000.dma and dw_axi_dmac_platform f0010000.dma
dma_controllers.cross_check: the vendor specification lists 8 DMA channels - matches

pcie.note: no PCI device is enumerated: /sys/bus/pci/devices is empty, /proc/bus/pci does not exist, and lspci is not installed. The complete-version specification lists PCIe Gen2 x4 and the lite version lists PCIe x1; neither could be confirmed on site.
pcie.official_spec_value: Gen2 x4 (完整版) / x1 (轻量版)

ethernet.measured_link: 100 Mb/s, Full Duplex, MII, link detected yes
ethernet.note: the PHY negotiated 100 Mb/s although 1000baseT is advertised and supported; the link partner also advertises only 10/100

usb.controller: dwc2 e0045000 (host DMA enabled); e0046000 disabled in the device tree
usb.observed_devices: root hub 1d6b:0002, USB 2.0 hub 0424:2514, USB HID keyboard 17ef:a03b (Lenovo MCP01)

spi.controllers: cadence,qspi spi@e0000000 (okay), snps,dw-apb-ssi spi@e0021000 (okay), spi@e0001000 and spi@e0020000 disabled

i2c.value: both controllers disabled in the device tree

video.value: 2 x SDI input, 1 x HDMI output (完整版/lite specification)
video.note: not verifiable from the running system; the board currently runs an SDI capture workload (see resources.json background_load)

rtc.note: not read out during this collection
